top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic Gran Fondo Argentina's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before October.

Road-specific control matters at Gran Fondo Argentina. Practice on flat to gently rolling urban terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 75 miles.
75 miles on flat to gently rolling urban terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Gran Fondo Argentina's flat to gently rolling urban terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
When someone attacks on flat to gently rolling urban terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Gran Fondo Argentina. Train it until it feels boring.
At Gran Fondo Argentina, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Gran Fondo Argentina. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Gran Fondo Argentina's flat to gently rolling urban terrain actually does to you.
2-minute all-out efforts on flat to gently rolling urban terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Base fitness for Gran Fondo Argentina. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.

race_overlay.weather: October in Parque Sarmiento, Buenos Aires, Argentina — October is early spring in Buenos Aires — generally mild, with real rain risk. The 2024 edition ran in rain. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks, including rain protection and wet-road braking before Gran Fondo Argentina. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Gran Fondo Argentina's 75 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. The organizer has not published a reliable resupply plan, so rehearse a self-sufficient carry and revise it when the rider document is released.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Gran Fondo Argentina rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on flat to gently rolling urban terrain to build confidence.
